english.title: Use a coach / bus / goods vehicle without a speed limiter plate

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) a

(A)_[coach,]_
(B)_[bus,]_
(C)_[goods vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) and which was fitted with a speed limiter without being equipped in a conspicuous position in the driving compartment with a plate which was clearly and indelibly marked with the speed at which the speed limiter had been set
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 70A(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
